method: manual editorial review; no classifier or scientific authorship certification
scope: GitHub Markdown rules; Vercel MDX metadata and website framework rules do not apply
checks: same commands and defaults across languages
preserved factual limits and fixed versions

changes: named Claude Code as the execution actor
kept failure and approval constraints as concrete actions

korean.style: technical document; 합니다 statements and 하세요 actions; code identifiers remain English
korean.grammar: manual spelling, spacing, particles and punctuation pass; standardized 원본 영상
korean.humanizer: manual pass across punctuation, spacing, noun-heavy phrasing, vocabulary, structure and translation patterns; no automatic AI detection
korean.meaning: versions, commands, defaults, outputs and blocked-versus-success status retained

cold_review: one isolated read; P2 prerequisite gap corrected; no repeat review
